name: Seerr Loading Screen
description: Show Sonarr/Radarr pending downloads as Jellyfin library items with live progress.
overview: Surfaces Jellyseerr-requested media via Sonarr/Radarr queue as a browseable Jellyfin channel with progress overlays. Backed by a small Python side-car daemon (jslsd) that polls the Arr APIs.

versions.changelog: Retarget to Jellyfin 12 (.NET 10, targetAbi 12.0.0.0): bumped TargetFramework to net10.0 and Jellyfin.Controller/Jellyfin.Model to 12.0.0. No plugin source changes were required for the Jellyfin 12 API surface — build is clean with 0 warnings/0 errors. Not yet verified end-to-end against a running Jellyfin 12 server.

Robustness pass: Channel listing now bounded by a 5s timeout against a hung daemon, smarter cache-key (state-hash, not timestamp) so refreshes only happen when items change. Daemon refactored: shared httpx client, ~200 LOC reduction. Verified end-to-end on Jellyfin 10.11.8.

Fix: register IChannel in DI container so Jellyfin actually discovers and lists the channel. Verified end-to-end on a live Jellyfin 10.11.8 server. Adds --demo flag to the daemon for first-run preview.

v0.2.0: implemented IChannel for browseable virtual library. Pending Sonarr/Radarr downloads now appear as a Jellyfin channel with progress posters. Native iOS/Android/tvOS support via baked PNG overlays.
